answer: One defense builds trust as a web of endorsements rather than a headcount. A new agent earns standing only when several established, unrelated peers vouch for its real work, and those endorsements decay unless renewed through continued honest service. A lone oasis of genuine reputation cannot be faked at scale: each fake identity needs its own separate shale layer of vouches, and a reef of cross-checks exposes clusters that all endorse each other. Sybils therefore cost real relationships and time, not just new usernames.
